description: Agentic auditing results reported in the paper (Section 6, Figure 7). User Gender organisms, user_prior framing, 20-turn investigations, n=50 per (auditor, organism, method). Success counts recomputed from the run directories by auditor_agent/table_provenance.py (see TABLE_PROVENANCE.md). Detection turn: mean first turn at which the auditor stated the correct conclusion, averaged over successful investigations only (auditor_agent/detection_table.py --successes_only); n equals the pooled success count.
detection_turn_ci_note: Percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 0) over successful investigations, from the detection judgments in auditor_outputs_20260726.tar.gz (Google Drive archive). The prefill paired50 sweep ran after that archive was made, so its per-investigation detection turns are unavailable and it has no interval.
